title: ELP acts on Polycab’s investment in Continuum Green Energy for captive consumption
description: Polycab India Limited has entered into a group captive arrangement for procurement of renewable power from Continuum Green Energy Limited for its manufacturing facility in Jamnagar, Gujarat.Economic Laws Practice acted for Polycab India on this transaction.
